instruction: Create a native panel from the Altium board file `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc`. Save the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wifi_panel.PcbDoc`. Target panel constraints: - The embedded source board document must still be `WiFi.PcbDoc`. - The array must be `4` rows by `3` columns. - `ROWSPACING` must be `1133.8583mil`. - `COLSPACING` must be `1338.5827mil`. - The array object must keep `MIRROR=TRUE` and `ORIGINMODE=1`. - The resulting board must contain route tool-path data intended for panel fabrication. [Software] To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).
